research_question: What is the effect of child-feeding interventions compared to no-intervention controls on children's short-term vegetable intake (<12 months follow-up)?
outcome_description: Children's vegetable intake measured short-term (<12 months following intervention, assessed via grams consumed, portions, daily frequency, or feeding trial intake)
positive_direction: A positive effect size indicates higher vegetable intake in the child-feeding intervention group compared to the control group.
search_queries: child feeding intervention vegetable intake trial
children vegetable consumption feeding intervention controlled comparison
preschool child vegetable intake feeding practice quantitative outcome
inclusion_criteria: Empirical controlled studies evaluating child-feeding interventions (e.g., repeated exposure, sensory education, parent feeding guidance) aimed at promoting vegetable consumption in children.
Inclusion of a no-intervention, waitlist, or usual-care control group for comparison.
Quantitative reporting of children's vegetable intake assessed short-term (<12 months post-intervention).
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, commentaries, and theoretical papers are excluded).
No comparison between a child-feeding intervention and a no-intervention or standard-care control group.
No extractable quantitative outcome data for vegetable intake (means and SDs, change scores, or test statistics required to calculate an effect size).
Outcomes evaluated exclusively at ≥12 months post-intervention, or study completely unrelated to child vegetable consumption.
moderators_to_extract: Intervention strategy (e.g., repeated exposure, sensory play, parent training, multicomponent)
Child age group (e.g., infants/toddlers 0-2y, preschoolers 3-5y, school-age 6-12y)
Outcome measurement method (e.g., weighed intake/plate waste, food diary/recall, food frequency questionnaire)
Timing of post-intervention assessment (e.g., immediate post-test vs. 1-6 months follow-up)
effect_size_note: Standardized mean difference (SMD / Hedges' g) will be calculated to pool diverse measurement scales of vegetable intake (e.g., grams consumed, portions per day, dietary frequency, plate waste).
